planned_work.title: Secure Windows remembered-device session

planned_work.title: Targeted Windows Cargo executable unlock before Tauri build

planned_work.title: Resilient client startup session restoration after LoopRD outage
planned_work.acceptance_criteria: After a cold start while offline, retained session reconnects with bounded, serialized retries and server identity validation. Permission failures do not delete valid vault; explicit retry/account switching and logout work on native Windows.

planned_work.title: OpenClaw headless Tavi messaging integration
planned_work.acceptance_criteria: Dedicated Tavi account via existing Social SDK; private session; contacts, direct messages, lobby, incremental inbound polling; skill docs and tests; no false game-play claims.
